title: The Wish
goal: Tell the AI what kind of game you want to make.
mascot_lines: Every game starts as a wish — a little spark of an idea.
Wishes start fuzzy, and that's okay. They get clearer as you build.
Small wishes are easier to test than giant ones.
And it's totally fine to change your wish as you learn new things along the way.

tier2.rephrase: Type a wish that includes 'jump' and 'world'.

tier3.nudge: Try: 'I want a hero who can run and jump in a world with levels'.

sandbox.hint: Tell Claude what kind of game you want!
